name: decode_joystick_state_bits
description: Folds bit pairs of the stored joystick port word into a five-bit mask with four movement bits and one fire bit, where the fire bit is set when the stored flag bit is clear. The joystick data and fire-button registers are the hardware sources behind the stored word.

name: exchange_shared_longword
description: Returns the previously stored 32-bit value, stores the argument in its place, and clears the word that follows it. It works as a swap on one shared 32-bit cell.

name: random_below_limit
description: Advances the shared 32-bit seed with a linear congruential step and returns its high word, or that word reduced modulo the argument plus one when the argument is not the special sentinel value. If the reduced range is invalid it calls a fallback routine to produce the value.

name: peek_random_high_word
description: Advances the shared 32-bit seed with a linear congruential step and returns the high word of the new seed without any other change. The seed keeps the advanced value.

name: mix_position_word_into_seed
description: Adds a 16-bit word read from the vertical and horizontal position register into the shared 32-bit seed. Each call changes the seed by the value read.

name: program_display_window_registers
description: Writes the display window limits, data fetch limits, bitplane modulo values and mode control to the custom chip registers, then sets the top bit of the DMA control word to enable the channels. A helper routine is called before and after these writes.

name: save_and_reprogram_display_registers
description: Saves the values returned by two helpers, writes the same display window, fetch, modulo and DMA control sequence as its neighbour, then restores the two saved values through the helper and writes the final DMA control word.

name: dispatch_write_page_state
description: Switches a shared page-state word between a few fixed values, calls helpers to set up each page, and spins while a second flag word is nonzero. A diagnostic string in the executable names a write page routine that has no default case.

name: toggle_busy_flag
description: Sets a 16-bit flag to one when it was zero and to zero otherwise, so each call flips the flag between those two states.

name: save_and_latch_pair_state
description: Saves a flag and a shared accumulated word, and when the flag was already set it stores its two parameters, calls the helpers and records a further value. It returns the saved flag and word together as one 64-bit value.

name: compute_positive_remaining_count
description: Returns the difference between a stored value and a helper result, plus one, but never less than one. The helper is called twice before the difference is taken.

name: wait_until_flag_clear
description: Busy-waits until the shared status word reads zero, then returns zero.

name: chain_helper_calls_with_constant
description: Passes the second parameter through one helper, feeds its result with the first parameter into a second helper, then calls a third helper with a fixed constant of twenty thousand and that result.

name: fill_bitplanes_from_mask
description: Walks five bitplane pointers and, for each plane, calls a fill helper with a fixed count of four thousand and one bit of the mask. When the mask is zero it makes a single fill call with a fixed count of twenty thousand instead.

name: copy_rectangle_across_planes
description: Takes a rectangle given as four coordinates and calls a block copy helper once for each of five bitplanes, passing the origin, the size and a row stride of twenty. The copy moves data from one set of five planes to another.

name: blit_rectangle_on_masked_planes
description: Takes a rectangle and a five-bit plane mask, and copies the rectangle with a block helper for each plane whose mask bit is set, using a row stride of twenty.

name: unpack_five_plane_image
description: Reads a packed header word whose bits select, per plane, either a copy of that plane's source data or a solid fill from the colour bits, and then calls a helper when the first parameter is nonzero. The copy and fill use blocks of four thousand words per plane.

name: select_mode_value_or_helper
description: Returns the code unchanged for the first three codes, returns the shared word for two further codes, and for any other code calls a helper with the shared word address and the code.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

name: read_shared_longword
description: Returns the current value of the shared 32-bit cell and changes nothing.

name: read_current_page_id
description: Returns the shared 32-bit cell that holds the current page identifier. A diagnostic string elsewhere in the executable reports a bad page identifier parameter.

name: get_page_slot_value
description: Returns the 32-bit entry of a three-slot table when the argument is zero to two, and returns the shared longword for the codes three and four. Any other code is passed to an error helper together with the table address.

name: reset_viewport_rectangle
description: Clears the origin fields of a shared rectangle, sets its width to 320 and its height to 200, then calls a helper to apply the new values.

name: set_shared_origin_and_record
description: Stores the first two parameters in the shared origin cells, copies a two-word record from the pointer argument into the shared pair cells, and then calls a helper.

name: read_shared_origin_fields
description: Copies the two shared origin words out through the two pointer arguments.

name: save_shared_record_pair
description: Writes the two shared pair words into the two-word block at the pointer argument.

name: load_shared_record_pair
description: Copies a two-word record from the pointer argument into the shared pair cells and then calls a helper to apply it.

name: compute_clip_edge_values
description: Derives four edge values from the origin and extent fields of a shared rectangle, using a span of 200 lines for the vertical edges and taking the horizontal far edges one short of the extent. The values are stored in shared cells after a helper call.

name: draw_world_group_entries
description: Walks a list of world entries, sends each one to a per-option helper with its coordinates, and reports an error through a helper for an option outside the valid range. It then swaps certain tile identifiers for their companions and redraws, returning whether any draw changed output. A diagnostic string names a world group that is missing or a bad option.

name: draw_world_group_from_registers
description: Register-based variant of the world group drawer that walks the same entry list, applies the same tile identifier substitutions and redraws, and returns whether any redraw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_two
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier from a fixed list of pairs, starting at the second pair of the list, then redraws. If the draw reports a change it applies a further substitution and redraws again.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_three
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the list of pairs from its third entry onward, then redraws and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_four
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the list of pairs from its fourth entry onward, redraws, and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_five
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the list of pairs from its fifth entry onward, redraws, and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_six
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the list of pairs from its sixth entry onward, redraws, and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_seven
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the list of pairs from its seventh entry onward, redraws, and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: remap_tile_id_from_pair_eight
description: Replaces the stored tile identifier using the last pair of the list, redraws, and returns whether the draw changed output.

name: redraw_fixed_tile_then_remap
description: Sets the stored tile identifier to a fixed value and redraws. If the draw reports a change it applies one more fixed substitution and redraws again, returning whether either draw changed output.

name: draw_fixed_tile_identifier
description: Sets the stored tile identifier to a fixed value, redraws it, and returns whether that draw reported a change.

name: return_parameter_unchanged
description: Returns its 32-bit argument unchanged, with no memory access, helper call or other effect.

name: draw_screen_group_entries
description: Checks a group record and its mode byte, walks the group's list of entries through a per-option helper, then calls a draw helper with the selected coordinates. Returns whether that final draw reported a change.

name: clear_shared_state_cells
description: Sets a block of shared state cells to zero.

name: return_parameter_unchanged
description: Returns its 32-bit argument unchanged, with no memory access, helper call or other effect.

name: set_option_value
description: Stores the arguments into shared option cells chosen by an option id from zero to nine, writing one cell or a pair of cells for each id. An id outside that range is passed to an error helper that reports it.

name: compute_shape_cell_offset
description: Converts index arguments for a shape record into a linear cell offset, where the record's type byte selects one, two or three axes and its extent bytes give each axis size. A sentinel index selects the last cell on that axis, and out-of-range indices go to an error helper before the offset is passed on with the record.

name: set_shape_index_checked
description: Checks a single index against the extent byte of a shape record, replacing a sentinel index with the last index, and passes the checked index with the record to a helper. An index outside the extent is reported through an error helper.

name: set_shape_two_index_checked
description: Checks two indices against the two extent bytes of a shape record, replacing sentinel indices with the last index on each axis, and combines them into one offset. It then passes that offset with the record to a helper, and reports out-of-range indices through an error helper.

name: decode_shape_header
description: Reads the header bytes of a shape record and fills shared cells with its data position, its width and height from the low seven bits of two bytes, signed origin offsets, flags from the high bits, and derived word counts. A helper first locates the header.

name: clip_shape_to_viewport
description: Tests a shape at a given position against the shared clip rectangle, trimming its horizontal and then vertical extent to the visible part. It stores the clipped source offset, the amount trimmed on each side and the visible height, and returns one when anything remains visible and zero otherwise.

name: call_with_saved_rectangle
description: Saves the shared origin and pair values, calls a helper with the two arguments, then restores the saved rectangle through another helper and returns the first helper's result.

name: return_parameter_unchanged
description: Returns its 32-bit argument unchanged, with no memory access, helper call or other effect.

name: square_and_dispatch_values
description: Calls two helpers, then either passes zero-based values to one helper or squares a shared cell and passes that square and the sum of the square and the cell to two helpers. A further helper is called when a shared flag is set, and the branch depends on whether a group of shared cells is zero.

name: compute_word_aligned_span
description: Computes the span of a horizontal range held in shared cells in 16-bit word columns, rounding the far edge up to a word boundary. It stores the start column, the bit offset within the word, the last column and the number of columns covered.

name: sync_record_flag_bit
description: Compares bit two of a record byte with a shared flag and, when they differ, calls a helper and sets that bit to the shared flag's low bit. The same comparison and update is repeated for a second record byte.

name: select_routine_by_five_bits
description: Combines two parameters into a single index and then tests each of five bits of it, storing either a routine address or a derived value for each bit. A separate path handles an index of zero, and the chosen result is stored in a shared cell before a helper call.

name: write_pixel_across_bitplanes
description: Sets or clears one pixel across five bitplanes at a given point, writing each plane whose mask bit is set and clearing the others. It returns one when the point lies inside the shared rectangle and zero otherwise.

name: check_rectangle_bounds
description: Checks that a four-word rectangle lies within the 320 by 200 screen and has positive width and height. An invalid rectangle is reported through an error helper.

name: classify_rectangle_extent
description: Returns zero when a rectangle has inverted edges, one when it is empty, two when it extends past the 320 by 200 screen, and three when it is a valid visible rectangle.

name: classify_rectangle_from_pointer
description: Classifies the rectangle at the address register as empty, off-screen or valid, returning one for an empty rectangle, two for one that extends past the 320 by 200 screen, and three otherwise.

name: classify_rectangle_bounds_only
description: Returns two when the rectangle at the address register extends past the 320 by 200 screen and three otherwise, without checking for empty rectangles.

name: intersect_rectangle_with_clip
description: Clips the first rectangle to the second by raising its left and top edges and lowering its right and bottom edges. It returns one when a non-empty area remains and zero otherwise.

name: return_true_constant
description: Returns one with no other work.

name: draw_text_lines_justified
description: Draws a multi-line string inside a rectangle, placing each line one step lower than the last, and sets each line's horizontal start from the justification mode. Justification values outside the valid range are reported through an error helper.

name: read_text_input_line
description: Reads key codes through a helper and stores printable characters into a text buffer, removing the last character on a backspace and ending on a carriage return. Typed text and a cursor are redrawn through helpers at each step, and the stored character count is returned.

name: finish_text_input_session
description: Runs the text input loop until the final key arrives, then ends the session through helpers and returns the stored character count.

name: handle_text_input_key
description: Handles one key of the text input loop: it stores a printable character or removes the last one on a backspace, redraws the text, and returns the updated count.

name: run_text_input_key_loop
description: Repeats the single-key text input step, storing or removing characters and redrawing, and returns the stored character count when the loop finishes.

name: run_text_input_until_terminator
description: Runs the text input loop, redrawing the typed text and storing characters as they arrive, until the terminating key is received. It returns the number of characters stored.

name: process_pending_text_input_key
description: Processes the most recent key read by the text input loop, storing or removing a character and redrawing before reading the next key.

name: loop_text_input_until_key
description: Loops over the text input steps until the key received matches the terminating code, redrawing and storing characters as each key arrives.

name: loop_text_input_until_final_key
description: Repeats the text input step until the key received equals the final code, then returns the stored character count.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

name: draw_text_string_to_position
description: Draws a line of text character by character from a font, advancing the horizontal position by each glyph's width and stopping at a line end or the terminator. Spaces only advance the position, and the returned pointer marks where drawing stopped.

name: measure_text_string_width
description: Adds up the advance widths of the printable characters in a line, stopping at a line end or the terminator, and returns that total less one when it is nonzero.

name: get_glyph_advance_width
description: Returns the advance width of a character: zero outside the printable range, three for a space, and otherwise the low seven bits of a width byte looked up from the font table.

name: ensure_resource_block_loaded
description: Loads a memory block for a resource record, either by reading it from disk or by using a block already in memory, and repeats the disk read in a loop while it fails. Its referenced text asks for the game disk to be inserted into drive zero and reports that memory could not be expanded for a block.

name: release_resource_block
description: Releases the block referenced by a record when one is set, clears the record's pointer, and returns one when a block was released and zero otherwise.

name: read_disk_blocks_into_record
description: Reads a block of data from disk in pieces of up to six thousand one hundred forty-four bytes, deriving the starting position from the record's memory address, and copies each piece to memory or passes it through a helper. A failure is reported with the text block unpack failed.

name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of the requested size from a free list, rounding odd sizes up to the next even size and initialising the list on first use. It returns the address of the allocated region, or zero when no free block is large enough.

name: free_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a block of a given address and size to a sorted free list, merging it with neighbouring free blocks that touch it. A block outside the managed heap is reported through an error helper.

name: claim_free_heap_slot
description: Searches a table of ten twenty-byte heap entries for one whose in-use field is zero, marks that entry in use and returns it. When no entry is free it reports the failure getdheap failed through an error helper.

name: release_heap_slot
description: Clears the in-use field of a heap entry, marking it free for later claims.

name: test_index_against_bound
description: Compares the argument against a shared bound using two opposing comparisons and returns zero when either holds. As written the two comparisons cover every case, so the routine always returns zero.

name: get_shape_entry_address
description: Returns the address of a shape within a shape group from the group pointer and an index. It reports through error helpers a null group, a group whose data is not available, or an index beyond the group's count.

name: lookup_shape_entry_or_zero
description: Returns the address of a shape entry like its neighbour does, but returns zero instead of reporting when the group is null or the index is negative or beyond the group's count.

name: lookup_shape_entry_from_frame
description: Frame-based variant of the shape lookup that returns the address of the shape entry when the index is in range and zero otherwise. A group that is not available is reported through an error helper.

name: lookup_shape_entry_unchecked
description: Returns the address of a shape entry from the frame's group and index without range checks. A group that is not available is reported through an error helper.

name: get_frame_entry_address
description: Returns the address of a frame within a frame group from the group pointer and an index. It reports through error helpers a null group, a group whose data is not available, or an index beyond the group's count.

name: get_colormap_entry_address
description: Returns the address of a colour map entry within a colour map group from the group pointer and an index. It reports through error helpers a null group, a group whose data is not available, or an index beyond the group's count.

name: get_binary_entry_address
description: Returns the address of a binary data entry within a binary group from the group pointer and an index. It reports through error helpers a null group, a group whose data is not available, or an index beyond the group's count.

name: check_unpack_completed
description: Runs an unpacking step into a destination buffer, either with a given source or a default one, and reports a failure when the returned pointer differs from the expected destination. The failure is reported with the text can't unpack data.

name: format_double_as_text
description: Converts a double-precision number into decimal text in a buffer, choosing fixed or general notation from the format character and a precision argument. The precision defaults to six and is capped at seventeen digits, a minus sign is written for negative values, and digits are produced by scaling by powers of ten in blocks of nine.

name: format_printf_style_text
description: Parses a printf-style format string, reading flags, field widths and precisions, with a width or precision given as an asterisk taken from the argument list. Each conversion is formatted through helpers into a 512-byte local buffer.

name: format_fixed_buffer_message
description: Formats its arguments into a fixed output buffer and calls a helper when a shared status flag bit is clear. It returns the formatter's result.

name: format_into_string_stream
description: Sets up a string output stream over the destination buffer with a large length limit, runs the formatter on the argument, then ends the string with a zero byte. It returns the formatter's result.

name: write_character_to_stream
description: Writes one character to an output stream, either directly through a helper for unbuffered streams or into the stream buffer. When the buffer fills it is flushed through a helper, and the routine returns the character or minus one when a flush fails.

name: flush_stream_buffer
description: Writes the buffered bytes of an output stream through a helper and resets the buffer pointer to its start. It returns minus one when the write fails and zero otherwise.

name: reset_stream_pointer_to_start
description: Sets the stream's write pointer back to the start of its buffer and returns zero.

name: convert_integer_to_decimal_text
description: Writes a signed 32-bit number into a text buffer as decimal digits with a leading minus sign for negative values. Large values are divided by ten using shift and subtract steps, and the routine returns the number of characters written.

name: convert_integer_to_text_in_base
description: Converts an unsigned number into text in a base from two to thirty-six, falling back to base ten when the base is out of range. Digits above nine use letters, and the routine returns the number of characters written.

name: copy_bytes_to_buffer
description: Copies a run of bytes from the source to the destination one byte at a time, and returns the destination pointer.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Writes one byte value across a run of bytes in the destination, and returns the destination pointer.

name: clear_bytes_to_zero
description: Writes zero across a run of bytes in the destination, and returns the destination pointer.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the terminating zero byte of a string and returns that count.

name: add_double_precision_pair
description: Adds two double-precision floating-point values held as pairs of 32-bit words. It aligns their exponents with a shift loop, combines the mantissas, and handles the zero and infinity cases before normalising the result.

name: combine_double_precision_pair
description: Combines two double-precision floating-point values held as word pairs in the same way as its neighbour, comparing magnitudes and aligning exponents before the mantissas are combined. Zero and infinity inputs are handled separately.

name: dispatch_unresolved_jump_target
description: Calls a helper and then makes an indirect call through a target whose jump table could not be recovered, so the destination of that call is not known from this code.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper and returns, so it only forwards the call.

name: compare_signed_wide_values
description: Reduces each of two pairs of 32-bit words to a sign indicator of minus one, zero or one, and compares the magnitudes when the two indicators match. It returns the comparison results as a pair.

name: multiply_double_precision_values
description: Multiplies two double-precision floating-point values held as word pairs. It forms partial products from the 16-bit halves of the mantissas, adds them with carries, and normalises the result, with special handling for zero and infinity.

name: call_two_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls two helpers one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_helpers_passthrough
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns the register pair they leave behind, with no other work.

name: call_three_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls three helpers one after another and returns, with no other work.

name: strip_exponent_restore_implicit_bit
description: Keeps the mantissa bits of the high word of a double-precision value, removing the exponent bits. It sets the implicit leading mantissa bit when the exponent is neither zero nor the special value.

name: store_helper_result_to_pointer
description: Calls two helpers and stores the 64-bit value returned by the second at the address held in the address register.

name: shift_long_right_with_sign
description: Shifts a combined value one bit to the right and places the saved sign bit in the top position. When the shift count is small it first calls helpers to adjust the operands, and it returns the shifted 32-bit result.

name: rotate_word_pair_by_fields
description: Shuffles bits between a pair of 32-bit words using shift counts of eleven and twenty-one, and returns the combined pair.

name: normalise_mantissa_left
description: Shifts a 64-bit mantissa left until its top bit is set. When the shift count is at least thirty-two it first moves whole words, and it stops early when the top bit is reached.

name: normalise_and_round_mantissa
description: Shifts a mantissa right by the exponent deficit when the exponent is zero or below, collecting the bits shifted out. It then adds one to the exponent when the upper mantissa bits are all set, rounding the result.

name: round_mantissa_from_exponent
description: Shifts a mantissa right by the exponent deficit when the exponent is non-positive, and then adds one to the exponent when the upper mantissa bits are all set. The exponent is clamped to zero for the shift case.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

name: assemble_double_result_pair
description: Calls helpers to prepare two operands, sets a bit when either low word is nonzero, takes the sign from the top bits of both operands, and returns the combined pair.

name: normalise_mantissa_pair
description: Masks the exponent out of the upper mantissa word and shifts the mantissa left until its leading bit is set, when the exponent field is zero and the mantissa is nonzero.

name: subtract_double_precision_values
description: Subtracts or adds two double-precision values held as word pairs, swapping the operands so the larger magnitude is kept. It handles zero and special exponent cases, and returns the result pair.

name: divide_mantissa_restoring
description: Divides a double-width mantissa by a divisor using restoring shift and subtract steps. Quotient bits are collected in one register and the remainder is left in another, for a bit count held in a counter.

name: dispatch_unresolved_pair_target
description: Calls a helper and stores its 64-bit result at the pointer argument, then makes an indirect call through a target whose jump table could not be recovered.

name: extract_mantissa_with_sticky_bit
description: Takes the exponent field of a 32-bit value and rebuilds its mantissa with the implicit leading bit, shifting it into place. A sticky low bit is kept when bits are shifted out, and the adjusted value is returned.

name: pack_mantissa_with_sticky_bit
description: Packs a mantissa held in a register with a sticky low bit, which is set from the comparison of a flag byte, and returns the result shifted into position.

name: return_sticky_low_bit
description: Returns a fixed mantissa value with only its sticky low bit set, after a rotate and shift that positions it.

name: load_double_from_pointer
description: Returns the 64-bit value stored at the pointer argument.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other work.

name: test_shifted_pair_zero
description: Calls a helper when the shift count is small, then returns without a result after testing whether the combined value is zero and non-negative.

name: store_result_then_dispatch_unresolved
description: Calls two helpers, stores the 64-bit result of the second at the pointer argument, then makes an indirect call through a target whose jump table could not be recovered.

name: shift_double_word_pair
description: Shifts a pair of 32-bit words by a count held in a register, moving whole words for each block of thirty-two places.

name: call_helper_for_negative_count
description: Calls a helper only when the count held in a register is negative, and returns otherwise.

name: divide_unsigned_long_by_divisor
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend held in a register pair by a 32-bit divisor. Large divisors use a bit-by-bit restoring loop, while smaller ones use direct division, and the routine returns the quotient and remainder as a pair.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Forms the 32-bit product of two 32-bit values from 16-bit partial products, and returns it together with the second operand's halves swapped.

name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls one helper and returns, with no other work.

name: call_helper_return_register_value
description: Calls a helper and returns the value the helper leaves in a data register.

name: negate_result_on_flag
description: Calls a helper for a value and negates that value when the flag the helper leaves in an address register is nonzero. It returns the resulting value.

name: call_and_negate_on_flag
description: Calls a helper, then returns its first result, or the negation of that result when the second result left in an address register is nonzero.

name: initialise_runtime_state_block
description: Clears a large block of shared memory word by word, sets a group of shared state cells to fixed starting values, copies saved register values into further cells, and then calls a helper.

name: dispatch_unresolved_indirect_call
description: Makes an indirect call through a target whose jump table could not be recovered, so the destination of the call is not known from this code.

name: store_value_then_dispatch_indirect
description: Stores the register value into a shared cell and then makes an indirect call through a target whose jump table could not be recovered.

name: advance_shared_counter_bounded
description: Adds the argument to a shared counter and returns the counter's previous value. If the sum would exceed the limit of five hundred eighteen thousand one hundred forty-five, it returns minus one and leaves the counter unchanged.

name: return_minus_one_constant
description: Returns minus one with no other work.

name: return_third_argument
description: Returns its third 32-bit argument unchanged and ignores the first two.

name: call_global_byte_setter
description: Calls a routine that writes a constant byte to a global variable, and one other unnamed routine. No pseudo-code was produced for this routine, so this is known only from those calls.

name: update_audio_and_interrupt_registers
description: Writes to the four audio channel volume registers and to the interrupt control registers, including the interrupt enable and request registers, then calls one other routine. A write with the top bit set enables the listed interrupts, and a write without it disables them.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: A one-instruction routine with no pseudo-code available, called by one other routine. The single instruction cannot be identified from the evidence.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: A one-instruction routine with no pseudo-code available, executed directly during the reference run. The single instruction cannot be identified from the evidence.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: A one-instruction routine with no pseudo-code available, called and executed during the reference run. The single instruction cannot be identified from the evidence.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.

description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect on the program state.
